utterances.name: g2p Is it going to rain tomorrow?

sounds.name: Kick
sounds.hint: Lips burst on air the rising larynx compresses

sounds.name: Hi-hat
sounds.hint: Tongue-tip release into a short hiss

sounds.name: Open hat
sounds.hint: The hi-hat left ringing as a long hiss

sounds.name: Snare
sounds.hint: Lips burst, then the lower lip hisses against the teeth

sounds.name: Rimshot
sounds.hint: Back of the tongue bursts on larynx-compressed air

sounds.name: Inward snare
sounds.hint: A sharp breath in past the back of the tongue

sounds.name: Tongue click
sounds.hint: Tongue seals a pocket, hollows it and pops

sounds.name: Lip pop
sounds.hint: Sealed lips, the jaw drops, the lips pop open

sounds.name: Crash
sounds.hint: Back-of-tongue release into a long rounded hiss

sounds.name: Hum
sounds.hint: Hummed bass note through the nose
